'''Michael John Donoghue''' is an American evolutionary biologist, currently the [[Sterling Professor]] of Ecology and Evolutionary Biology at [[Yale University]], and also a published author.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Michael Donoghue {{!}} Department of Ecology & Evolutionary Biology |url=https://eeb.yale.edu/people/faculty/michael-donoghue |access-date=2022-08-17 |website=eeb.yale.edu |language=en}}</ref>

==Career==
Donoghue earned a bachelor's degree in Botany and Plant Pathology from [[Michigan State University]] in 1979. He attended [[Harvard University]] for his postgraduate work, attaining a Ph.D. in 1984. He found employment at [[San Diego State University]] from 1982 to 1985, the [[University of Arizona]] from 1985 to 1992, Harvard University from 1992 to 2000, and finally [[Yale University]] since 2000.<ref>{{cite web |title=Michael Donoghue Receives the 2017 ASPT Asa Gray Award |url=https://www.aspt.net/news-blog/2017/7/6/hans-walter-lack-receives-the-aspt-peter-raven-award-fjpmy-2xy47 |website=American Society of Plant Taxonomists |date=6 July 2017 |access-date=27 February 2023}}</ref>

Donoghue was also previously the Glaser Distinguished Visiting Professor at [[Florida International University]]. He is a Fellow of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]] and [[American Academy of Arts and Sciences]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://eeb.yale.edu/people/faculty/michael-donoghue |title=Michael Donoghue |publisher=yale.edu |accessdate=December 11, 2016}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=J67CrV8AAAAJ&hl=en |title=Michael Donoghue |accessdate=December 11, 2016}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.worldcat.org/identities/lccn-n90633365/ |title=Donoghue, Michael |publisher=worldcat.org |accessdate=December 11, 2016}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://donoghuelab.yale.edu/sites/default/files/files/Donoghue_CV_2015Oct22_full.pdf |title=CV |publisher=yale.edu |accessdate=December 11, 2016}}</ref>

He served as president of the [[Botanical Society of America]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Current Officers of the Botanical Society of America |url=https://botany.org/home/about/current-officers.html |website=The Botanical Society of America|access-date=26 February 2023 |language=en}}
</ref>
